description: Plainday's own source: ES modules, the class files among them in src/commands/, src/startup/ and src/shared/, which plugin/esbuild.config.mjs bundles into main.js. CodeMirror's packages are peers: Obsidian provides them, and the build leaves them out. ical.js is a dependency: the build bundles it into main.js. Both are listed here for the lint, which reads the package.json nearest each file; npm installs from the repository's package.json, at the root, which pins the same versions.
